Quo Vadis Clive? On hearing of your recent announcement to surrender the editor-ship of the 'Belgravian' one is forced to ask "What is the true signifieance underlying this decision?"

Editor here----could you give me the date Gwil Brown joined us?" There was a pause, a rustle of paper, the click of a pencil on the receiver, "Hallo! Clive-----there is no such name as Gwil Brown on our books".
Dear Clive, Will you please convey my sincere thanks to all Belgravians for the very generous donation for Mount Vernon Hospital - which I feel is a great tribute to Alf.

He was once described to me as "a real gentleman." I would think that he would have had an opinion on the article but would have been far too modest to own up to the description of him so well drawn by Clive.
Congratulations to Jodie and Clive on the safe arrival of their baby Matthew, a brother for Daniel. Baby Thomas Staines made his entrance on Sunday 22nd February and weighed in at 7lbs 2oz.
